reviews.text: i have bought this so many times that i lost count. it has very simple ingredients - good for calming fungal acne skin.
reviews.zh: 我已經回購咗無數次，數都數唔清。成分好簡單——有助舒緩真菌引致嘅暗瘡皮膚。

reviews.text: グリセリンクリーでサラサラの化粧水が好きなのですが、思ったよりもペタペタ感がありました。
reviews.zh: 我一直鍾意 Glycerin Clean 嗰種清爽嘅爽膚水，但呢款比我預期中更加黐立立。

reviews.text: It is nice a calming on my redness and to any active pimples, I like it had a nice watery and quickly absorbing texture compared to other toners i have used with high levels of single ingredients. I had no reaction or break it to it and left my skin feeling densently moisturized for the lin layer I used
reviews.zh: 對我泛紅同正在發炎嘅痘痘都起到唔錯嘅舒緩作用。相比起我用過嘅其他高濃度單一成分爽膚水，我鍾意佢水潤而且吸收快嘅質地。我用完冇任何不良反應或者爆瘡，薄薄一層已經令皮膚感覺好水潤。

reviews.text: I've been using this toner with the serum from same line. It works well with acne prone skin and doesn't cause breakout.
reviews.zh: 我一直用呢款爽膚水配合同系列嘅精華。對容易生暗瘡嘅皮膚好有用，而且唔會引致爆瘡。

reviews.text: This is a basic soothing and moisturizing toner, with a clean composition. I use it only with pads, leave it for 3 minutes and the skin is super moisturized. It is perfect for dry, sensitive skin.
reviews.zh: 呢款係基本嘅舒緩保濕爽膚水，成分乾淨。我只會用化妝棉嚟敷，敷 3 分鐘之後皮膚就變得好水潤。非常適合乾性、敏感肌。

reviews.text: This is really great for sebum production! As someone with combo skin in the winter, I made the mistake of putting this toner all over my face. It left my oily areas matte and my dry areas even dryer. I think this is great for the summer or if you want to focus it on your t zone! I typically use this and then pair it with a hydrating toner and my skin is Glowy but not oily!! In terms of soothing, I would give this 2/5. It does a little but nothing too noticeable.
reviews.zh: 控油方面真係好出色！冬天我塊面係混合性，結果我錯手將呢款爽膚水搽勻成塊面，搞到油性位置變霧面，乾性位置仲乾過之前。我覺得呢款比較適合夏天用，或者只係針對 T 字位。我通常會用完佢再配一支保濕爽膚水，皮膚就會有水光感但又唔會油笠笠！舒緩方面我會畀 2/5，係有少少作用但唔算好明顯。

reviews.text: Definitely good for sensitive skin and acne prone skin. I recommend if you looking for something that is not irritating.
reviews.zh: 絕對適合敏感肌同容易爆瘡嘅皮膚。如果你係搵緊一款唔刺激嘅產品，我推薦呢款。

reviews.text: It's surprisingly very hydrating and lightweight for a toner. Would 100% recommend this to all skin types. It also helped to control my sebum production on my oily t-zone.
reviews.zh: 對爽膚水嚟講，佢保濕力強又輕盈，實在令人驚喜。所有膚質我都 100% 推薦。仲有，佢幫到我控制油性 T 字位嘅皮脂分泌。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
